title: review: R1: orchestrator/duration.py — empirical task-duration estimates with robust statistics and deterministic cold-start priors (AP P5)
spec:
Why: critical_path.est_duration_s (orchestrator/critical_path.py:15-24) only knows COLD_START_S per band or a caller-supplied durations dict; nothing computes empirical durations, so critical-path ranking and waves use crude assumptions (AP P5, brief .orchestrator/roadmap-completion-program.md P2).
What: new module orchestrator/duration.py, pure, no daemon changes.
- actual_s(task) -> float|None: pipeline.gated_at - pipeline.claimed_at (same definition as scorecard.parallelism, scorecard.py:1481), else sum of runs duration_s rows for role execute if given rows; None when unknown.
- history(root=STATE) -> list of {task, task_class (attribution.task_class), executor (task.executor or tier), band (attribution.band), actual_s} over merged execute tasks (merged_into set) with a known actual_s; tolerate missing/malformed task files.
- estimate(task, root=STATE, cfg=None) -> {"est_s", "source", "n", "band", "task_class", "executor"}; evidence ladder, first level with n >= min_samples wins: (task_class, executor, band) -> class_executor; (task_class, band) -> band_class; (band) -> band; else cold_start = critical_path.COLD_START_S[band]. Statistic: median when n < 10, otherwise trimmed median dropping trim fraction from each tail (default 0.1). cfg from pool_config()['scheduler']: duration_mode = "empirical"|"cold_start" (default empirical; cold_start forces priors), duration_min_samples (default 5), duration_trim (default 0.1); unknown mode -> empirical.
- durations_for(tasks, root=STATE, cfg=None) -> {task_id: est_s} keyed by task id (critical_path.est_duration_s reads task-id keys first), plus explain_for(tasks, ...) -> {task_id: estimate dict} for telemetry.
- prediction_error(predicted_s, actual_s) -> {"abs_s", "ratio"} or None.
No pool.toml edit (defaults in code). Docstrings state the ladder. Bus reads via bus.read/bus.get or the tasks directory under root.
acceptance: tests/test_duration.py::test_cold_start_uses_band_prior_when_no_history — no merged tasks: estimate returns COLD_START_S for the band with source cold_start and n 0
tests/test_duration.py::test_sufficient_history_uses_class_executor_median — 6 merged tasks of the same class, executor and band return their median with source class_executor and n 6
tests/test_duration.py::test_sparse_history_falls_back_down_the_ladder — 2 class_executor samples and 5 band samples yield source band, never false precision from the 2
tests/test_duration.py::test_trimmed_median_resists_outliers — 12 samples with two 50x outliers estimate within 10 percent of the clean median

tests/test_duration.py::test_explain_for_records_source_and_sample_size — explain_for returns est_s, source, n, band, task_class for every task and durations_for keys match task ids; duration_mode cold_start forces priors
